items.title: Why Marvell Technology Stock Fell Hard in October
items.summary: Investors continued to exit AI positions, and news of a new Marvell acquisition sent shares falling.

items.summary: Key TakeawaysFabrinet shares fell 33% in the past month as AI optics stocks sold off on fears about AI funding, and Lumentum, Marvell and Coherent fell even further. Fabrinet’s fiscal first-quarter revenue rose 51% to a record $1.

items.title: Marvell Sinks 36%, Lumentum Drops 31% on $115 Billion Deal: Is the Selloff Overdone?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMarvell Technology (MRVL) shares declined approximately 36% between October 28 and November 4, closing near $160 as investors questioned its proposed acquisition of Lumentum. Lumentum (LITE) fell approximately 31% over the same period, closing near $627 as Marvell’s declining share price reduced the value of its all-stock takeover offer.

items.title: Marvell (MRVL) Stock Looks Undervalued After Its 166% Three Year Run
items.summary: Marvell Technology has given shareholders a powerful multi year ride, yet the recent slide in the share price and a major AI focused deal leave a simple question hanging over the stock. Is the current valuation still justified by the earnings the chip designer is generating today and what it may realistically earn in the years ahead. Over the past 3 years the share price has gained about 166%, which puts a lot of weight on whether the earnings profile can support that step up in market...

items.title: Seagate Soars 10% in AI Rebound as Morgan Stanley Sees “Strong Fundamentals and Weak Sentiment”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSeagate shares jumped 10% today as AI hardware stocks, including Coherent, bounced back from last week’s selloff. Morgan Stanley kept Seagate as a top pick with a $1,148 price target, citing its strong fundamentals and weak sentiment.

items.title: Coherent Soars 18%, Lumentum Up 12% as AI Optics Rebound Extends Despite Nvidia Turmoil
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCoherent shares jumped 18% today with no company news, as AI hardware stocks rebounded. Lumentum, Astera Labs and Nebius rose too, even as Nvidia fell on its board’s probe of CEO Jensen Huang.
